la:other:Caieta.html:
Cāiēta, ae (and -ē, ēs), f., = Καιήτη.
The nurse of Æneas, ; .—
A town and harbor in Latium, now Gaëta, ; ; ; ; Serv. ad Verg. l. l.; .—Hence, Cāiētānus, a, um, adj., of Caieta: villa,.

la:other:Caicus.html:
Căīcus (Căȳcus, ), i, m., = Κάικος.
A river of Greater Mysia, which takes its rise on Mt. Teuthras, passes near Pergamus, and flows into the sea opposite Lesbos; now the Bakhir Tchai, ; ; ; ; ; ; ; .—
One of the companions of Æneas, ; .
